title: DA, DPWH ink P430-M farm road projects in Mimaropa

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture’s (DA) regional office in Mimaropa and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) signed an agreement to undertake P430 million worth of farm-to-market road (FMR) projects in the region. Under the accord, the DA’s regional office in Mimaropa and the DPWH will collaborate to implement 29 FMR projects across the region, designed to enhance connectivity between agricultural production areas, markets, and major road networks.
